nativeFixes.change: Preserve a durable worker model deadline through supervision instead of reporting generic dispatch_error.
Derive advertised process timeouts from registered profiles; return process_timeout_exceeded/max_timeout_ms before dispatch for excessive budgets.
Describe the literal argument contract and derive executable_name from the trusted registered program. The backend supplies the program and fixed prefix.
Return policy-denied workspace reads as durable failed tool results; keep dependency/private traversal guards and ownership validation.
Return typed missing/wrong-type/content file-read failures as recoverable tool results. Preserve cancellation, foreign ownership, stale lease and unrecordable-outcome failures.
